en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑story neoclassical railway station building with people standing and sitting on the platform in front of it. Train tracks run across the foreground. The facade has arched and rectangular windows, and a central entrance with a small portico. The building bears the name "DZĒRBENE," and the word "LATVIJA" appears in the lower left corner of the postcard. In the lower right corner the place name "DZĒRBENE" and a number are printed along with a small emblem.
